list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (list frozen 2026-11-18).

notes.rarity: No source publishes a trustworthy earn rate for a game this new, so this guide shows none. Rarity sorting orders trophies by grade, then Gamerscore.
notes.missable: One trophy is flagged as possibly missable by the launch guides: Positive Mental Attitude. Nothing else is reported missable.
notes.points: PSN points follow PlayStation's standard values: Bronze 15, Silver 30, Gold 90, Platinum 300.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to hunt directly. Work the roadmap in this app stage by stage and let it be the last pop of the run — A Long Road (100% completion) is the long pole, and everything else feeds it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; structure cross-checked on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission that brings Jason and Lucia to the Leonida coast. It is story-related and cannot be missed: play through the prologue and it pops at the mission's end.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status and Gamerscore: PlanetGTA6, cross-checked with GTABase.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 1; the trophy lands as the chapter closes. It cannot be missed. One warning while you are here: the first meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude is offered at home during this chapter and is reported to vanish afterwards, so meditate there before you move on.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; missable note: PowerPyx and GTABase.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2's mission chain. Story-related and unmissable — keep following the main markers and it arrives with the chapter's end. (Yes, the asterisks are really how PlayStation prints this one's name.)
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. The Cartel Heist (Break the Bank) sits inside this chapter in GTABase's chapter notes, so that hidden bronze should arrive on the way. Story-related; cannot be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; chapter placement: GTABase.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Story-related and unmissable.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This gold closes the campaign; everything after it is the open-world sweep toward 100%. Keep a manual save just before the finale if you like being able to revisit the ending.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status and Gamerscore: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named main mission, so it pops simply by following the story markers; it cannot be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission in GTABase's notes. Story-related and reported as can't-be-missed; it pops as the heist wraps up.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; chapter placement: GTABase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears on the map. Story-related; follow the main markers and finish it.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story-related and unmissable.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission in GTABase's notes, set around the airport. Story-related and can't be missed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; chapter placement: GTABase.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story-related; it pops at the mission's end.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist — the biggest single ask on the list, and worth 100 Gamerscore on Xbox. Launch guides note the checklist is kinder than it looks (PowerPyx estimates it at roughly 60% of everything the game tracks), but it still has to be finished after the story, and most of it overlaps the other trophies: strands, collectibles, activities, exploration. Use this tracker's per-grade bars to watch it close in.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles; difficulty notes: PowerPyx and GTABase.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — stunt jumps and stunt events across Leonida all feed the total PlayStation tracks. They are spread over the whole map, so sweep region by region after the story and trust the in-game counter rather than a tally of your own.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types once — races, fishing, the arcade, bowling and the rest each need a single attempt, not a win. Do this tour early: it also shows you which activities hide trophies of their own.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each weapon's recoil on the early ranges first, then work range by range: gold scores reward accuracy under the clock, so short controlled bursts beat spraying.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Winning — not merely entering — is what counts, so learn each course with a practice run, then race it clean.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeating the same race does not add to the count PlayStation tracks. Mix street, off-road and water races as they unlock, and keep a note of which ones you have already won — this tracker is a good place.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is one of the locals you meet around the water; accept the challenge when it is offered and fish cleanly — landing your catches matters more than racing the clock.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish, at any arcade cabinet in Leonida. If you only want the pop, pick the shortest game on the cabinet.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand by completing his final mission. Stranger strands open as you explore and as the story advances; work each strand's markers as they appear so the finals are all unlocked before the endgame.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand by completing his final mission. As with the other strangers, the strand's earlier jobs must be done first — clear them as they surface rather than saving them all for the end.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand by completing his final mission. Keep Billy's markers in your rotation whenever you are in his part of the state and the finale will unlock in good time.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida — PlayStation tracks completed strands, not started ones. The named finals in this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone) plus Bret's hunting strand are the backbone; finish strands one at a time and use this tracker to see which are done.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand by completing his final mission. Randy's jobs are the supply runs his strand is named for; clear them as they appear and the finale follows.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by completing his final mission. Same rhythm as the other strangers: earlier jobs first, finale last, all of it trackable in this app's Strands filter.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, which sit in 10 locations across Leonida. This is the one trophy the launch guides flag as potentially missable: the first spot, offered at home during Chapter 1, is reported to become permanently unavailable after that chapter — so meditate there before you move on, and keep a Chapter 1 save as insurance. Every later spot can be swept up in the endgame.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count and spot locations: PSNProfiles and GTA-Zone; missable warning: PowerPyx and GTABase.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for, as part of his strand. Take the tracking slowly and bring a scoped rifle; the unique animal is a one-off encounter tied to Bret's missions, not a random spawn.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. The cards are scattered through interiors and landmarks; work one set at a time so your progress is easy to audit against the in-game collection page.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use a WAiNK machine at 100 different locations. They are all over the state's shops and public buildings; clear each district as you explore it, so the last twenty are not a scavenger hunt across the whole map.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges unlock through activities and exploration, so this usually lands during the open-world sweep; if it lags behind, work the challenge list in the pause menu from shortest to longest.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape cleanly. Do it in free roam so a failure costs nothing: start trouble, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars drain away.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, without letting the wanted level fully drop between them. Pick three shops on one street, move fast, and never hide long enough for the heat to reset.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Traffic variety differs by district — rich, rural and industrial areas spawn different sets — so if the count stalls, cruise the neighbourhoods you rarely visit and get in anything new.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus activation. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang operation, or a robbery gone loud — and trigger Focus only when five targets are already in view.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA, the airport, in an 'unscheduled' way: take a plane and get airborne outside a mission's script. It is easiest around the VCIA story missions, when you are already on the airfield; otherwise hop the fence in a fast car and grab a light aircraft.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a wink: Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this one pops around facing one down. Launch guides have not pinned the exact trigger yet, so treat it as a happy-accident trophy — when a Rhino rolls out during high-heat mayhem, stay in the fight instead of fleeing. We will sharpen this guide as the method is confirmed.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; trigger unconfirmed in launch guides: GTA-Zone.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without being detected. Go at night, deal with cameras and any guard quietly before you touch the cases, and leave by the back.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs are the heavy end of the robbery ladder: bring your partner, plan the exit vehicle before you go in, and expect a long wanted tail on the way out.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Block it in on a side street, deal with the guards, get the rear doors open, then swap vehicles to break the chase.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Areas register as you enter them, so a deliberate endgame road trip through any grey patches left on the map finishes this off; the islands and the far coast are the usual stragglers.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang's operation sits in its own turf; clear one per district as you sweep the map and keep track of which colours you have already hit.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach — a quiet early moment the game hides as a trophy. It is there from the opening hours around the Ocean Beach bars: stop, order the drink, and take in the view.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, through the glass, 'in classic style' — a nod to a famous moment from the series' past. Get into a car inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the storefront.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish the game there rather than quitting mid-frame. Any score counts; the trophy is for bowling at that specific alley.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description points at a shared moment for the two protagonists, played out in front of an audience — but launch guides have not confirmed the exact trigger yet. Play the partner content as it comes and expect this during a story-adjacent scene; if it has not popped by the finale, check the sources below for the confirmed method.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; trigger unconfirmed in launch guides: GTA-Zone.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a count of 500 choices for this one: dialogue and decision prompts across the whole game add up, so it rewards playing everything rather than grinding one spot. Finish the story and the strands first; if the count comes up short, replayable content with choices closes the gap.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Guides describe a hidden second-chance event: fail at something the game lets you retry, then succeed on the second attempt. The exact event is still unverified in launch coverage, so do not force it — across a full playthrough it is expected to happen on its own.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; method reported as unverified: U7Buy's trophy list.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of the game's strange, unexplained encounters — Leonida's weird side. The precise trigger is unconfirmed in launch guides; explorers report these moments out in the remote parts of the map, so the exploration sweep for The Goodtime State is your best chance.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; trigger unconfirmed: U7Buy and GTA-Zone.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: swing from a moving vehicle and connect. Do it at low speed on a quiet street so the swing — not the car — makes the contact.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; hidden status: PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts; PlayStation tracks the running total. Marked bills come from the bigger robberies — route them through your contacts as they arrive instead of sitting on them, and the total lands during the money sweep.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops; PlayStation tracks the total. Vehicles, weapons, clothes and property all count. A platinum run crosses this naturally — and if it lags, the garage-buying spree for Little Boxes closes it.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties on the map. They unlock as your money grows; buy them during the money sweep, once the robbery trophies are paying out.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register each new vehicle as you discover it and this counter climbs together with Whip It Good's 100 discoveries.
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase; count: PSNProfiles.
